0224.title: Dimethyl carbamoyl chloride
0224.exposureRoutes: inhalation, skin absorption, ingestion, skin and/or eye contact
0224.symptoms: irritation eyes, skin, nose, throat, respiratory system; eye, skin burns; cough, wheezing, larnygitis, dyspnea (breathing difficulty); headache, nausea, vomiting; liver injury; [potential occupational carcinogen]

0659.title: Vinyl cyclohexene dioxide
0659.nioshRel: Ca TWA 10 ppm (60 mg/m3) [skin] [See Appendix A]
0659.exposureRoutes: inhalation, skin absorption, ingestion, skin and/or eye contact
0659.targetOrgans: Eyes, skin, respiratory system, blood, thymus, reproductive system
0659.symptoms: In Animals: irritation eyes, skin, respiratory system; testicular atrophy; leukopenia (reduced blood leukocytes), necrosis thymus; skin sensitization; [potential occupational carcinogen]

0447.title: Nitric acid
0447.physicalDescription: Colorless, yellow, or red, fuming liquid with an acrid, suffocating odor. [Note: Often used in an aqueous solution. Fuming nitric acid is concentrated nitric acid that contains dissolved nitrogen dioxide.]
0447.nioshRel: TWA 2 ppm (5 mg/m3) ST 4 ppm (10 mg/m3)
0447.exposureRoutes: inhalation, ingestion, skin and/or eye contact
0447.symptoms: irritation eyes, skin, mucous membrane; delayed pulmonary edema, pneumonitis, bronchitis; dental erosion

0474.title: Oxalic acid
0474.physicalDescription: Colorless, odorless powder or granular solid. [Note: The anhydrous form (COOH)2 is an odorless, white solid.]
0474.exposureRoutes: inhalation, ingestion, skin and/or eye contact
0474.symptoms: irritation eyes, skin, mucous membrane; eye burns; localized pain, cyanosis; shock, collapse, convulsions; kidney damage

0515.title: Picric acid
0515.physicalDescription: Yellow, odorless solid. [Note: Usually used as an aqueous solution.]
0515.exposureRoutes: inhalation, skin absorption, ingestion, skin and/or eye contact
0515.symptoms: irritation eyes, skin; sensitization dermatitis; yellow-stained hair, skin; lassitude (weakness, exhaustion), myalgia, anuria, polyuria; bitter taste, gastrointestinal disturbance; hepatitis, hematuria (blood in the urine), albuminuria, nephritis

0129.title: Chloromethyl methyl ether
0129.physicalDescription: Colorless liquid with an irritating odor.
0129.exposureRoutes: inhalation, skin absorption, ingestion, skin and/or eye contact
0129.symptoms: irritation eyes, skin, mucous membrane; pulmonary edema, pulmonary congestion, pneumonitis; skin burns, necrosis; cough, wheezing, pulmonary congestion; blood stained-sputum; weight loss; bronchial secretions; [potential occupational carcinogen]

0144.title: Coal dust
0144.physicalDescription: Dark-brown to black solid dispersed in air.
0144.nioshRel: TWA 1 mg/m³ [measured according to MSHA method (CPSU)] TWA 0.9 mg/m³ [measured according to ISO/CEN/ACGIH criteria] See Appendix C (Coal Dust and Coal Mine Dust)
0144.oshaPel: TWA 2.4 mg/m³ [respirable, < 5% SiO₂] TWA (10 mg/m³)/(%SiO₂ + 2) [respirable, > 5% SiO₂] See Appendix C (Mineral Dusts) See Appendix G
0144.symptoms: Chronic bronchitis, decreased pulmonary function, emphysema

0608.title: Thallium (soluble compounds, as Tl)
0608.physicalDescription: Appearance and odor vary depending upon the specific soluble thallium compound.
0608.exposureRoutes: inhalation, skin absorption, ingestion, skin and/or eye contact
0608.targetOrgans: Eyes, respiratory system, central nervous system, liver, kidneys, gastrointestinal tract, body hair
0608.symptoms: nausea, diarrhea, abdominal pain, vomiting; ptosis, strabismus; peri neuritis, tremor; retrosternal (occurring behind the sternum) tightness, chest pain, pulmonary edema; convulsions, chorea, psychosis; liver, kidney damage; alopecia; paresthesia legs

0174.title: DDT
0174.physicalDescription: Colorless crystals or off-white powder with a slight, aromatic odor. [pesticide]
0174.exposureRoutes: inhalation, skin absorption, ingestion, skin and/or eye contact
0174.targetOrgans: Eyes, skin, central nervous system, kidneys, liver, peripheral nervous system
0174.symptoms: irritation eyes, skin; paresthesia tongue, lips, face; tremor; anxiety, dizziness, confusion, malaise (vague feeling of discomfort), headache, lassitude (weakness, exhaustion); convulsions; paresis hands; vomiting; [potential occupational carcinogen]

0370.title: Lindane
0370.physicalDescription: White to yellow, crystalline powder with a slight, musty odor. [pesticide]
0370.exposureRoutes: inhalation, skin absorption, ingestion, skin and/or eye contact
0370.targetOrgans: Eyes, skin, respiratory system, central nervous system, blood, liver, kidneys
0370.symptoms: irritation eyes, skin, nose, throat; headache; nausea; clonic convulsions; resp difficulty; cyanosis; aplastic anemia; muscle spasm; In Animals: liver, kidney damage
